messages:
nina-docs: Quick report from onboarding: the embedded playground snippet in the README is out of date. It still POSTs to `https://playground.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and uses model `rwd-legacy`. The public playground was updated to /v2 and `rwd-legacy` is retired; people see a CORS error or a 404 when clicking the live example.

omar-playground: Ack, we updated the hosted playground last month and forgot to sync the embedded iframe snippets. The iframe also injects a global `REDWOOD_TOKEN` var instead of reading from the snippet's env, which confuses users trying to run the example locally.

faye-support: Two tickets this week where customers clicked the embedded example, got an error, assumed SDK or API was down, and opened a support request. They included screenshots which clearly show the old endpoint.

ellis-sdk: We should do three things: (1) update the README embedded snippet to call /v2 and a current model, (2) change the example to demonstrate using a mock token and explain how to swap in a real key, and (3) add a small integration that renders the playground snippet in CI with a mocked service so the embed is tested on docs deploy.

omar-playground: I can add a small test harness that spins up a local mock server, loads the iframe HTML, and asserts the sample JS calls the expected /v2 path and model. We'll run it in the docs CI job.

nina-docs: Also let's avoid hardcoding model names in the README snippets. Use `model: process.env.EXAMPLE_MODEL || 'rwd-small'` with a short comment. That will make future model deprecations less noisy.

faye-support: Please also add a brief troubleshooting note under the playground embed: "If the live example errors, check that your browser blocks third-party cookies or that your ad-blocker isn't blocking the iframe." Many users have privacy extensions that break embeds.

ellis-sdk: PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/589 - updates embed to /v2, switches to rwd-small default, documents token handling, and adds the playground smoke test in CI. Also adding a docs-lint rule to flag hardcoded retired model names in codeblocks.

ci-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1601 for the embed test and the lint. CI will now run the mock-playground check on docs deploy.

omar-playground: I'll follow up to add the mocked endpoint to the internal test harness and add a short note in the console UI about using DEVELOPMENT_MODE for local testing.

nina-docs: Thanks team  should cut down on the "example broken" tickets and make the embedded playground more reliable.

faye-support: :thumbsup:
